summary: Lawrence repeatedly and personally labeled Israel's attacks on Gaza a genocide—at a Latino community forum, in social-media posts, and as a core credential of his MI-7 campaign. His platform calls for stopping arms sales to Israel and pursuing diplomatic solutions rather than military escalation. Vote for Peace rated him an Ally for the general, and DMFI spent roughly $1 million against him via Rolling Sea PAC.
